title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: The Tigers, who signed catcher Derek Norris in 2018 after serving a suspension for domestic violence, are “interested” in shortstop Addison Russell, who served a suspension for domestic violence last season, according to @JonHeyman.

If the Tigers were to sign Russell, who served a 40-game suspension for domestic violence while playing with the Cubs last season, they would set the record for most players signed after serving a domestic violence suspension in Major League history.
Definitely not the last one
